The bundled OpenSans-{Regular,Italic,Bold,BoldItalic}.ttf files are version
1.10 from pinned VisPy. Their embedded name table states:
Digitized data copyright (c) 2010-2011, Google Corporation.
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
The matching Apache-2.0 text is OpenSans-Apache-2.0.txt.
These files predate Open Sans's 2021 OFL relicensing.

No external fonts are downloaded to render the deterministic text fixtures.
